item.title: Hotel Architect Adds Christmas Content In Latest Update
item.description: Hotel Architect has been given a holiday update with Christmas additions, as well as bellhops and room servives to schedule

item.title: Twinkleby Launches New Yuletide Event For The Holidays
item.description: Twinkleby has its own holiday update available now, as their Yuletide Event brings with it a number of snowy and festive additions

item.title: Greenland 2: Migration – 3 New High-Quality Character Posters Released
item.description: Lionsgare released three more character posters for Greenland 2: Migration, which will be released in theaters on January 9, 2026.

item.title: Vampire Crawlers Releases New Gameplay Trailer
item.description: Check out the latest trailer for the game Vampire Crawlers as the developers show off more of the gameplay to this new spinoff title

item.title: The Bride! – New Behind-The-Scenes And High-Quality Images Released
item.description: One new behind-the-scenes image and one new high-quality image from Maggie Gyllenhaal's The Bride! have been released.

item.title: Madden: Nicolas Cage Is John Madden In The First Teaser Trailer
item.description: Prime Video has released the first teaser trailer for Madden, starring Nicolas Cage as the biopic's central figure, John Madden.

item.title: Emperor of the Fading Suns Enhanced Adds Additional Support
item.description: A small update was released for Emperor of the Fading Suns Enhanced this month, providing the game with some additional support
